The '''Ytha'ac Cluster''' was a cluster of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] located within the [[Ytha'ac system]],<ref name="XWvTF" /> in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were to meet with [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who had stolen a stock of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] munitions. However, the Imperials had sent a strike force consisting of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]]s to [[Battle near the Ytha'ac Cluster|recover]] the pilfered supplies.<ref name="XWvTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The outcome of the ensuing battle depends on the side the player takes.<ref name="XWvTF" />
